target.title: Machine Learning Engineer
target.description: Build and deploy machine learning models, work with TensorFlow/PyTorch, Python, data pipelines, model evaluation, MLOps, cloud ML platforms.

examples.title: Machine Learning Engineer
examples.description: Build ML models for drug discovery using TensorFlow and PyTorch. Work with data scientists to deploy models to production on GCP ML Platform.

examples.title: Senior Data Scientist
examples.description: Lead the development of recommendation systems and deep learning models. Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch, MLflow for experiment tracking.

examples.title: AI Research Scientist
examples.description: Research and publish novel ML algorithms for AI safety. TensorFlow, JAX, Python. Publish at NeurIPS and ICML.

examples.title: MLOps Engineer
examples.description: Build data pipelines and MLOps infrastructure for ML model deployment. Kubernetes, Docker, Python, MLflow.

examples.title: Data Engineer
examples.description: Design and maintain data pipelines. Python, Spark, Airflow, SQL. Work with data scientists on feature engineering.

examples.title: Sales Representative
examples.description: Sell enterprise software solutions to Fortune 500 companies. Quota-driven, B2B sales, CRM (Salesforce).

examples.title: Marketing Manager
examples.description: Run digital marketing campaigns across social media and email. SEO, SEM, analytics, brand management, content creation.

examples.title: HR Business Partner
examples.description: Manage employee relations, recruitment, performance reviews. HR policy, benefits administration, onboarding.

examples.title: DevOps Engineer
examples.description: Maintain CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, monitoring.

examples.title: UX Designer
examples.description: Design user interfaces for mobile and web products. Figma, Sketch, user research, prototyping, design systems.
